messages.subject: custom geom guidelines?
parts: Is there a manual or guide somewhere where I can learn on how to construct custom geoms?

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: custom geom guidelines?
parts:
I suspect you may have already seen this, but AFAIK this is as close
to an 'official' document on the subject:

https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/Creating-a-new-geom

The ggthemes package has a couple of geoms, so perhaps a gander at the
source code might be useful.

Dennis
